sentences.en: The service nobility was a pillar of the Prussian state.
sentences.zh: 服务贵族是普鲁士国家的支柱。

sentences.en: A large pillar obstructs the view of the lake.
sentences.zh: 一根大柱子挡住了湖景。

sentences.en: Ignorance and fear, those are the two pillars of any religion.
sentences.zh: 盲目无知和恐惧，这是任何宗教的两大支柱。

phrases.zh: 伊斯兰教五功（或称伊斯兰教的五大支柱）
